name: Hemlock Water-parsnip
desc: Hemlock Water-parsnip (Sium suave): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 2 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Sium suave, the water parsnip or hemlock waterparsnip, is a perennial wildflower in the family Apiaceae. It is native to many areas of both Asia and North America.
